repo_url.name: Repository URL
repo_url.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of the Git repository to track.

branch.name: Branch
branch.description: Branch or ref to check out (defaults to main).

access_token.name: Git access token
access_token.description: Personal access token for private Git repositories.

ha_access_token.name: Home Assistant API token
ha_access_token.description: Long-lived Home Assistant token used when Supervisor access is unavailable.

ha_base_url.name: Home Assistant base URL
ha_base_url.description: Base URL for direct Home Assistant API calls.

ha_verify_ssl.name: Verify HA SSL certificates
ha_verify_ssl.description: Enable when the Home Assistant base URL has a trusted certificate.

target_path.name: Deployment target path
target_path.description: Directory where changed files are copied (usually /config).

git_depth.name: Git clone depth
git_depth.description: Shallow clone depth; set to 0 for full history.

ha_event_name.name: Event name
ha_event_name.description: Event fired after a successful sync.

notify_on_startup.name: Notify on startup
notify_on_startup.description: Send a notification after the first successful sync.

verify_ssl.name: Verify Git SSL certificates
verify_ssl.description: Toggle TLS verification for the Git remote.

mqtt_topic.name: MQTT topic
mqtt_topic.description: MQTT topic used when publishing changes.

mqtt_username.name: MQTT username
mqtt_username.description: MQTT username if authentication is required.

mqtt_password.name: MQTT password
mqtt_password.description: MQTT password if authentication is required.

mqtt_qos.name: MQTT QoS
mqtt_qos.description: Quality of Service level for MQTT messages.

mqtt_retain.name: MQTT retain flag
mqtt_retain.description: Retain MQTT messages on the broker.

http_api_port.name: HTTP API port
http_api_port.description: Port exposed by the FastAPI management endpoint.
